move.text:
Hello,

Our offer is a price of €33.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days.

Besides this, we can also offer a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days at standard terms. To give you a discount down to €31.00, we need to trade the lead time back to 52 days, as rushing it would just add costs.

Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. We have free capacity for your parts.

Our offer is a price of €28.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

We can drop the price to 28.00 EUR for Option A, but we really need to keep payment at 30 days. 28 days is already the fastest we can push this through the shop. Our Lieferzeit is 28 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium.

We just machine to your drawing, so we can't change the design or material on our end. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.10 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.82 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.51 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
